bns:Component.name: Send_TransactionLog_Upsert_V2
bns:Component.bns:description: MERGE upsert into EDV_INTEGRATION.TRANSACTION_LOG for Scheduled_TransactionLog_Consumer, run through a Standard Insert operation (the connector rejects programmatic Update operations). Request JSON keys must be UPPER-CASE real column names, in the order of the ? placeholders; START_DATE carries the event timestamp, already converted to yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS by the process (the connector rejects ISO 8601 with T and Z, error 405). Any event (START, SUCCESS, ERROR) creates the row if missing and a later event completes it, so delivery order does not matter. SQL Server allows one WHEN MATCHED UPDATE only, hence the CASE expressions. | built with boomi-companion v1.0.57

field.value: MERGE EDV_INTEGRATION.TRANSACTION_LOG WITH (HOLDLOCK) AS T USING (SELECT V.TRANSACTION_ID, V.CORRELATION_ID, V.INTERFACE_ID, V.OBJECT_TYPE, V.BUSINESS_KEY, V.SOURCE_SYSTEM, V.TARGET_SYSTEM, V.ENVIRONMENT, CASE WHEN V.STATUS = 'START' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE V.STATUS END AS STATUS, CAST(V.START_DATE AS datetime2(3)) AS START_DATE FROM (VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)) AS V (TRANSACTION_ID, CORRELATION_ID, INTERFACE_ID, OBJECT_TYPE, BUSINESS_KEY, SOURCE_SYSTEM, TARGET_SYSTEM, ENVIRONMENT, STATUS, START_DATE)) AS S ON T.TRANSACTION_ID = S.TRANSACTION_ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.STATUS = CASE WHEN S.STATUS <> 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN S.STATUS ELSE T.STATUS END, T.END_DATE = CASE WHEN S.STATUS <> 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN S.START_DATE ELSE T.END_DATE END, T.START_DATE = CASE WHEN S.STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND S.START_DATE < T.START_DATE THEN S.START_DATE ELSE T.START_DATE END, T.DURATION_MS = DATEDIFF(MILLISECOND, CASE WHEN S.STATUS = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND S.START_DATE < T.START_DATE THEN S.START_DATE ELSE T.START_DATE END, CASE WHEN S.STATUS <> 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN S.START_DATE ELSE T.END_DATE END) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TRANSACTION_ID, STATUS, START_DATE, END_DATE, DURATION_MS, CORRELATION_ID, INTERFACE_ID, OBJECT_TYPE, BUSINESS_KEY, SOURCE_SYSTEM, TARGET_SYSTEM, ENVIRONMENT) VALUES (S.TRANSACTION_ID, S.STATUS, S.START_DATE, CASE WHEN S.STATUS <> 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN S.START_DATE END, CASE WHEN S.STATUS <> 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 0 END, S.CORRELATION_ID, S.INTERFACE_ID, S.OBJECT_TYPE, S.BUSINESS_KEY, S.SOURCE_SYSTEM, S.TARGET_SYSTEM, S.ENVIRONMENT);
